specs.title: ETM-8869 - Hover, selected, focus and disabled layers on a highlighted row

annotations.description: step 1 needs a person: Row 8 (task row, menu says Work Breakdown) highlighted FFFB8F. While hovered, Description cell has an extra layer rgba(24,144,255,0.14) over background-color rgb(255,251,143) (FFFB8F kept, not replaced). Mixed colour has no exact value: a person judges the picture. | step 2 needs a person: Row selected (double-click No. cell, class b-selected): every cell keeps background-color rgb(255,251,143) with layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) on top. A single click selects one cell only (layer 0.14/0.08), it does not select the row. Mixed colour: a person judges the picture. | step 3 needs a person: Clicked Description cell: it gets b-focused, background-color stays rgb(255,251,143); no colour layer and no outline/box-shadow was measured for focus (outline none), so the focus look is not measurable. A person must look at the picture. | step 4 needs a person: Clicked an empty area above the grid: background-color of all cells = rgb(255,251,143), but the row stays selected (layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) still on cells 3-8) and the focus stays; clicking outside does not clear the selection. Not exactly FFFB8F: a person decides. | step 7 needs a person: Duration cell keeps class b-readonly-cell, layer rgb(245,245,245) and text rgb(89,89,89) over background-color rgb(185,224,255) (row also selected, layer 0.08). Mixed colour, no exact value: a person judges the picture.

steps.title: 1. Move the mouse over the highlighted Work row
steps.why: Row 8 (task row, menu says Work Breakdown) highlighted FFFB8F. While hovered, Description cell has an extra layer rgba(24,144,255,0.14) over background-color rgb(255,251,143) (FFFB8F kept, not replaced). Mixed colour has no exact value: a person judges the picture.

steps.title: 2. Click the row to select it
steps.why: Row selected (double-click No. cell, class b-selected): every cell keeps background-color rgb(255,251,143) with layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) on top. A single click selects one cell only (layer 0.14/0.08), it does not select the row. Mixed colour: a person judges the picture.

steps.title: 3. Click a cell of the row so it has focus
steps.why: Clicked Description cell: it gets b-focused, background-color stays rgb(255,251,143); no colour layer and no outline/box-shadow was measured for focus (outline none), so the focus look is not measurable. A person must look at the picture.

steps.title: 4. Click an empty area of the page
steps.why: Clicked an empty area above the grid: background-color of all cells = rgb(255,251,143), but the row stays selected (layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) still on cells 3-8) and the focus stays; clicking outside does not clear the selection. Not exactly FFFB8F: a person decides.

steps.title: 5. Record how the disabled cell of the Platform row looks with no highlight
6. Right-click the Platform row, open Highlight Row and choose B9E0FF
7. Look at the disabled cell
steps.why: Duration cell keeps class b-readonly-cell, layer rgb(245,245,245) and text rgb(89,89,89) over background-color rgb(185,224,255) (row also selected, layer 0.08). Mixed colour, no exact value: a person judges the picture.

steps.title: 8. Right-click the Platform row, Highlight Row, No Color, then reload without Save
